newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Oct 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Oct 20.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Palestinian Leader Yasser Arafat telephones UAE President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan.
- UAE interior minister meets top security officials for talks on how to implement residency law, says no extension to amnesty period granted to foreigners to correct their status.
- UAE asks developed countries to reduce debt burden on developing countries.
- GCC Secretary-General Jameel Hujilan in Qatar to prepare for Gulf Arab summit.
- Zayed gets cable from Ukranian President Leonid Kuchma.
